purpose: One human-understandable first task, with specialist paths opt-in and a common evidence/authority fabric

routes.prompt: Bring one thing you want to improve
routes.expected_first_success: User can describe one goal without learning CoAll vocabulary

routes.prompt: See a tentative next phrase, then reject or undo it
routes.expected_first_success: Preview does not type; Accept and Undo change only demo field

routes.audience: People learning how to check civic claims
routes.prompt: Explore a sourced civic question without joining a party
routes.expected_first_success: Reader distinguishes official source, inference and missing evidence

routes.prompt: Explore connected claims and their evidence
routes.expected_first_success: Reader finds a source and an explicitly unproved relation

routes.audience: People who learn through games or satire
routes.prompt: Try a fictional exhibit about civic evidence
routes.expected_first_success: Reader distinguishes explicit fiction, actual public source and unsupported claim

routes.prompt: Find one resource by intent and copy a safe evidence capsule
routes.expected_first_success: Copy explicit no-authority capsule while private locations remain redacted

namespace_contract.brand: Presentation and audience language only; does not imply separate ownership, deployment or authority
namespace_contract.domain: Actual DNS or HTTP address only after owner, TLS, routing, security review and exact external HTTP acceptance; aliases redirect unless qualified
namespace_contract.identity: User-controlled scoped identity, not one mandatory cross-brand tracking account
namespace_contract.role: Time-limited capability and permission under separate revocable authority
namespace_contract.node: Internal logical capability/receiver record; '.node' is NOT automatically a DNS top-level domain
namespace_contract.clone: Explicitly declared configuration or artifact fork; never impersonation, independent personhood or cloned access rights
namespace_contract.persona: Optional presentation style only; may not inherit financial, security, device or external action authority
namespace_contract.game: Opt-in sandbox with visible fiction and real-world-effect separation
namespace_contract.app: Declared executable interface with install, capability and rollback proofs; source page is not installed app
namespace_contract.use_case: First useful outcome plus proof gate; one can span multiple surfaces

routing_rail.default: no account; no automatic profile inference; no background redirect
routing_rail.selection: explicit visitor choice of a small task, with optional other interests afterward
routing_rail.context_transfer: no cross-route raw content or identity transfer without explicit scoped consent
routing_rail.source_of_truth: shared CoAll evidence/provenance and work-object IDs, not copied private customer profiles
routing_rail.no_surface_authority: a persona, brand, visual graph, game or clone cannot confer execution permissions
routing_rail.privacy: aggregate, opt-in first-party outcomes only when instrumented; this index implements no tracking
routing_rail.domain_fallback: GitHub START_HERE.md while custom domain routing/privacy remain under review

cooperation_competition.principle: shared proof contracts + diverse voluntarily chosen specialist routes, never manufactured agreement
cooperation_competition.eligible_comparison: one consenting first-use task, plain-language route versus same task through specialist entrance

scale_buffer.safety: rate limits, queue fairness, cancellation, budgets, overpressure shedding, circuit breaker, retry caps
scale_buffer.authority: no paid model, bulk email, credential, trading, site or device action from a source-route selection
scale_buffer.first_use: keep 1 default and a few optional routes; do not firehose every brand and persona

required_next_proof: one consenting new reader uses one of two routes, returns timestamped independent first-use task result; DNS/host needs separate external security review
